svg.title: Deletion intervals for the source mapping problem
svg.desc: Five deletion intervals reproduce the source membership across six numbered positions. A solid magenta segment denotes the region deleted, not retained. Del 1 covers 1-3, Del 2 2-3, Del 3 2-4, Del 4 3-5, and Del 5 4-6. Source: Lecture 11D mapping problem, original images 018 and 019. Positions are schematic, not genetic distances.
